hand_configuration: Both index fingers pointing upwards facing each other, brought together until index knuckles touch (MEET), followed by thumbs up (GOOD / HAPPY).
isl_grammar_structure: Compound idiom: [MEET] [GOOD] with reciprocal spatial directionality.
cultural_linguistic_notes: Standard respectful opening during new introductions among signers in India.

media.description: Two index fingers converging together to represent two people meeting, followed by approval.

source: ISLRTC Section 1: Common Greetings & Social Conversational Idioms
